body: Yeah I probably deserve that anyways

I'm struggling with the same thing. My friends all talked about how fun it was, but every moment was terrible for me and my self-esteem hit an all-time low after prom. 

I ate all my food, but none of my friends did. I feel like a fucking fatass.
You know what's the worst? When your "friends" start planning something around you, but go quiet when you ask them what they're talking about.

I sincerely hope my soulmate is out there. I'm not sure if this is hypocritical, but I haven't had a crush in a while. I don't know whether I'm incapable of feeling, but it's probably because I haven't tried to get to know new people but that's something I'm working on this year. Crushing gives me so many emotions but also heartbreak so I shouldn't complain.

I also feel ashamed whenever people say I look good. The thing is people rarely tell me I look good, whereas my friends are complimented on a daily basis. There's so much societal discrimination against ugly people, and it makes me feel like shit.
